full_prompt_en: A square, restrained painterly landscape shows a solitary seated figure facing a distant house beyond pale open fields. A broad gray-blue sky fills the upper third with little cloud detail. Near the upper center, an isolated cluster of steep-roofed buildings stands on a low rise. Cream walls, weathered brown siding, and a tall chimney make the small house legible, while a bare tree trunk or branch sits close to its left side. The land beneath is a sweep of pale beige and straw-colored planes, broken by thin horizontal brush marks and a shallow band of off-white. In the middle right, a single figure sits low on the near bank, seen from behind or three-quarter back. A light gray top and brown lower clothing make the body visible without competing with the distant building. The person's head tilts slightly toward the open space ahead; there is no legible facial detail. Dry tawny grass fills the lower middle and left, its short directional strokes flowing across the bank. Along the bottom right, a dark navy pool or narrow watercourse cuts into the pale earth, making a striking cool wedge in the otherwise warm ground. A few tiny vertical posts interrupt its near edge. There are no crowds, vehicles, or readable signs. The elevated viewpoint looks gently down across the bank, then levels toward the far rise. Light is overcast and diffuse, leaving only mild shadows beside the building and within the grasses. The surface appears worked with thin washes, dry brush, and faint grain, with important forms defined by modest tonal contrast rather than crisp outlines. The overall composition is sparse and contemplative, balancing the small distant structure and still figure against generous open land and sky.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、克制的绘画式风景描绘一名独坐人物，面对浅色开阔田野外的远方房屋。宽阔灰蓝天空占据上方三分之一，云层细节很少。靠近上方中央，一组陡顶建筑孤立在低坡上。乳白墙面、磨旧棕色侧板和一根高烟囱使小房子仍易辨，左侧附近还有一根光秃树干或枝条。其下土地由浅米色和干草色平面铺成，被细长水平笔迹和一条灰白色浅带打断。中右部，一名人物低坐在近岸，以背面或四分之三背面出现。浅灰上衣和棕色下装使身体可见，却不与远处建筑争夺注意力。头微微朝向前方开阔处，没有可辨脸部细节。干燥黄褐草丛占据下方中部和左侧，短促定向笔触横过岸坡。沿右下方，一片深海军蓝水洼或狭窄水道切入浅色土地，在原本温暖的地面上形成醒目的冷色楔形。近岸边有几根小小竖杆。没有人群、车辆或可读标牌。略高视点轻轻俯看岸坡，随后朝远处低丘趋于平视。阴天光柔散，仅在建筑旁与草丛间留下轻微阴影。表面像由薄洗染、干笔和淡颗粒处理，重要形状靠适度明度对比而非锐利轮廓界定。整体构图稀疏而沉思，以渺小远屋和静止人物平衡大块开阔土地与天空。
style_prompt_en: The restrained painterly style uses large quiet planes of pale beige, straw, gray-blue, and one deep cool accent. Thin washes and dry directional strokes leave the surface visibly worked but never crowded. Small structures or marks sit within generous open areas, making scale and distance more expressive than fine detail. Edges soften into surrounding tones; modest dark pockets supply just enough contrast to anchor the composition. Diffuse light produces little cast shadow, so color temperature and material texture carry the spatial separation. Broad horizontal bands and slight rises organize the image, while a compact dark foreground shape prevents the pale expanse from becoming weightless. The overall effect is spare and contemplative, with weathered pigment and deliberate emptiness creating emotional depth.
style_prompt_zh: 这种克制的绘画风格使用大块安静的浅米、干草、灰蓝色域，以及一处深冷色重音。薄洗染和干燥的定向笔触让表面显出手工处理，却从不拥挤。渺小结构或标记处在宽裕空白之中，使尺度与距离比精细细节更有表现力。边缘柔化进周围色调，少数适度深色空隙提供刚好足够的对比稳住构图。漫射光几乎不制造投影，色温与材料肌理承担空间分离。宽阔水平色带和轻微起伏组织画面，一块紧凑的深色前景形状防止浅色广域失去重量。整体效果稀疏而沉思，风化颜料与有意留白创造情绪纵深。
theme_en: A solitary seated figure faces a distant house beyond pale fields
theme_zh: 孤独坐着的人望向浅色田野外的远方房屋
name: Andrew Wyeth
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
